subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Frivolous
solution:
The solution is **Serious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of " *Frivolous *" is Serious.
 
• **Frivolous - **Not having any serious purpose or value. (कोई गंभीर उद्देश्य या मूल्य नहीं होना)
 
 
• **​​***For example : "Rules to stop frivolous lawsuits."*
